authority: Extract v1.0.2 §8 + Founder clarified endConfirm, accepted L-60..65

continue.selfNoConfirmation: Own-action confirmation uses continueNoFinal; not other-party approval
continue.mutualYes: Read-only chat and separate contact UI; never expose one-sided choices
continue.race: Read actual current state after save/withdraw; if mutual won, route read-only/contact; if closed/unavailable, apply that state. Never fake withdrawal or expose peer vote.

contact.publish: Explicit contactShare with selected values; real result only
contact.skip: Remain unshared and return to unlocked contact/read-only context
contact.edit: Own published field only; changes become visible only after explicit contactPublishChange success
contact.withdraw: Remove current visibility, not previously seen/saved copies
contact.remoteFields: Only currently published allowed values; no private draft or hidden values
contact.fieldValidation: Use existing server/client contract; no new formats, length constraints or required universal field invented
contact.blocked: All contact content removed; never show cached hidden value
contact.entryKey: contactChooseDetails opens form; does not publish

surfaceSeparation: Sent chat messages are immutable; contact records may be updated/withdrawn through separate actions.
